files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onUnmounted, watchEffect } from "vue"

import { useChart } from "./context"

// Unovis draws grid lines from the axes: horizontal lines come from ChartYAxis
// (keep one, even with `hide`), vertical lines from ChartXAxis.
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ horizontal?: boolean; vertical?: boolean }>(), {
  horizontal: true,
  vertical: false,
})

const { grid } = useChart()

watchEffect(() => {
  grid.horizontal = props.horizontal
  grid.vertical = props.vertical
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  grid.horizontal = false
  grid.vertical = false
})
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue"

import ChartLegendContent from "./ChartLegendContent.vue"
import { chartColor, useChart, type ChartLegendPayload } from "./context"

// Place it after the Unovis container inside Chart: it takes a row under the plot.
const props = defineProps<{
  /** Series to show. Defaults to every key of the Chart config. */
  keys?: string[]
  /** Entries to show instead of the config's. */
  payload?: ChartLegendPayload[]
}>()

const { config } = useChart()

const entries = computed<ChartLegendPayload[]>(
  () =>
    props.payload ??
    (props.keys ?? Object.keys(config.value)).map((key) => ({ dataKey: key, value: key, color: chartColor(key) }))
)
</script>

<template>
  <ChartLegendContent :payload="entries" />
</template>

chart/ChartTooltip.vue
files.content:
<script setup lang="ts" generic="Datum extends Record<string, unknown>">
import { h, render } from "vue"
import VisCrosshair from "@unovis/vue/components/crosshair"
import VisTooltip from "@unovis/vue/components/tooltip"

import ChartTooltipContent from "./ChartTooltipContent.vue"
import { chartColor, useChart, type ChartTooltipPayload } from "./context"

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const props = defineProps<{
  /** Field of the datum shown as the tooltip heading, like the category on the x axis. */
  labelKey?: keyof Datum & string
  /** Turns the datum into the heading. Wins over labelKey. */
  labelFormatter?: (datum: Datum) => string
  /** Series to list. Defaults to every key of the Chart config. */
  keys?: (keyof Datum & string)[]
}>()

const { config } = useChart()

function payloadOf(datum: Datum): ChartTooltipPayload[] {
  const keys = props.keys ?? Object.keys(config.value)
  return keys
    .filter((key) => datum[key] !== undefined)
    .map((key) => ({ dataKey: key, name: key, value: datum[key], color: chartColor(key) }))
}

// Unovis takes the tooltip as HTML: render the Vue content off-screen and hand over its markup.
function template(datum: Datum) {
  if (!datum) return ""
  const label = props.labelFormatter
    ? props.labelFormatter(datum)
    : props.labelKey
      ? String(datum[props.labelKey] ?? "")
      : undefined
  const el = document.createElement("div")
  render(h(ChartTooltipContent, { active: true, payload: payloadOf(datum), label, config: config.value }), el)
  const html = el.innerHTML
  render(null, el)
  return html
}

function circleColor(_datum: Datum, i: number) {
  const keys = props.keys ?? Object.keys(config.value)
  return chartColor(keys[i % Math.max(1, keys.length)] ?? "")
}
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Unovis puts its tooltip above the plot (z-index 999999); the box is see-through so ChartTooltipContent draws the card. -->
  <VisTooltip />
  <VisCrosshair :template="template" :color="circleColor" v-bind="$attrs" />
</template>

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts" generic="Datum extends Record<string, unknown>">
import { computed } from "vue"
import VisAxis from "@unovis/vue/components/axis"

import { useChart } from "./context"

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

// Other VisAxis props (numTicks, tickTextAngle…) pass through.
const props = defineProps<{
  /** Plot the x as the index (`:x="(_, i) => i"`) and name each tick from this field. */
  dataKey?: keyof Datum & string
  /** The chart data, needed with dataKey. */
  data?: Datum[]
  tickFormat?: (tick: number | Date, i: number) => string
  /** Hides the labels; grid lines from ChartGrid stay. */
  hide?: boolean
}>()

const { grid } = useChart()

const tickFormat = computed(() => {
  if (props.hide) return () => ""
  if (props.tickFormat) return props.tickFormat
  if (props.dataKey && props.data) {
    const { dataKey, data } = props
    return (tick: number | Date) => String(data[Math.round(Number(tick))]?.[dataKey] ?? "")
  }
  return undefined
})

const tickValues = computed(() => (props.dataKey && props.data ? props.data.map((_, i) => i) : undefined))
</script>

<template>
  <VisAxis
    type="x"
    :grid-line="grid.vertical"
    :tick-line="false"
    :domain-line="false"
    :tick-padding="8"
    tick-text-color="var(--muted-foreground)"
    tick-text-font-size="12px"
    :tick-format="tickFormat"
    :tick-values="tickValues"
    v-bind="$attrs"
  />
</template>

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import VisAxis from "@unovis/vue/components/axis"

import { formatChartValue, useChart } from "./context"

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

// Other VisAxis props (numTicks, tickValues…) pass through.
const props = defineProps<{
  tickFormat?: (tick: number | Date, i: number) => string
  /** Hides the labels; grid lines from ChartGrid stay. */
  hide?: boolean
}>()

const { grid } = useChart()

const empty = () => ""
</script>

<template>
  <VisAxis
    type="y"
    :grid-line="grid.horizontal"
    :tick-line="false"
    :domain-line="false"
    :tick-padding="hide ? 0 : 8"
    tick-text-color="var(--muted-foreground)"
    tick-text-font-size="12px"
    :tick-format="hide ? empty : (props.tickFormat ?? formatChartValue)"
    v-bind="$attrs"
  />
</template>
